ValueSet: HPO Phenotypic Observation Codes

Official URL: https://www.medizininformatik-initiative.de/fhir/ext/modul-seltene/ValueSet/mii-vs-seltene-hpo-phenotypic-observation-codes Version: 2027.0.0-ballot
Active as of 2026-09-02 Computable Name: HPOPhenotypicObservationCodes

Human Phenotype Ontology codes for phenotypic observations

References

  • MII PR SE Clinical Diagnosis
  • MII Profile SE Clinical Impression
  • MII Profile SE HPO Assessment
  • MII Profile SE Symptom Condition

Logical Definition (CLD)

  • Include all codes defined in http://human-phenotype-ontology.org version Not Stated (use latest from terminology server)

 

Expansion

Expansion from 127.0.0.1 based on codesystem Human Phenotype Ontology version 20250303

This value set has 31,154 codes in it. In order to keep the publication size manageable, only a selection (1,000 codes) of the whole set of codes is shown.
